$comment: Starting Helsinki city map (#913). Exactly two nodes are selectable at game start; everything else is locked and must not look playable. Grounded 1974 Helsinki - no saucers, no floating traffic, no neon skyline.
district_note: Sörnäinen/Kallio and Punavuori are real neighbourhoods; the map distinguishes them rather than inventing a fantasy city.

nodes.name: Home, Helsinginkatu
nodes.summary: Agency-provided starter apartment, moved into yesterday. Bare, unpersonalised, boxes still unpacked.
nodes.grounding: Working-class and bohemian Helsinginkatu: tram traffic, kiosks, bars, left intellectuals, artists, a neighbourhood gentrifying unevenly. Class contradiction with complexity, not caricature.

nodes.name: UNSA Helsinki Field Office, Ratakatu
nodes.summary: The former Suojelupoliisi headquarters, now the UNSA field office. It cannot decide whether it is SuPo, Europol or UNSA.
nodes.grounding: Overlapping authority and mixed paperwork, played straight. Any retrofuturist element belongs to the later-unlocked underground, not the street.
